grammar.summary: 本课学习宾语从句（whether/if 引导）与 as usual。

points.title: whether/if 宾语从句
points.explanation: I wondered if/whether it was a football. 间接疑问句用 whether/if 引导，从句用陈述语序。

examples.en: I turned to look at the children.

points.title: as usual 状语
points.explanation: as usual = 像往常一样，固定搭配：The ball went towards a passing boat as usual. 作插入状语。

examples.en: As usual, the river was full of people.
examples.cn: 和往常一样，河上满是游人。
